title: NY Fed President Williams flags another rate hike possible by year-end; 10-year Treasury yields near 5.2%
summary: New York Federal Reserve President John Williams stated at a public event that an additional rate increase before year-end 2026 remains a live option as the Fed assesses progress on inflation. The remarks pushed 10-year Treasury yields toward 5.2%, a fresh multi-month high.
why: Rising rate-hike expectations and elevated long-end yields raise the discount rate applied to equity valuations across the entire US/HK portfolio, increase margin costs for options strategies (sell-put, covered call), and are a primary macro driver for tech multiple compression.

title: Trump and Xi move to substantive talks at White House: trade truce, AI dialogue, tech controls on the table
summary: Following the Rose Garden ceremony, President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping held substantive working sessions covering the 90-day tariff truce, a bilateral AI safety dialogue framework, and the scope of U.S. technology export controls. SCMP reporting indicates both sides sought concrete deliverables ahead of Xi's return.
why: U.S.-China trade and tech-restriction trajectory is the largest macro variable for the HK-listed Chinese tech portfolio (腾讯, 阿里, 美团). Any tariff truce extension or easing of chip/AI export controls is a direct positive catalyst; breakdown risk is the key tail.

title: Crude oil volatile as U.S.-Iran talks signal Strait of Hormuz risk ease; Kepler tanker data tracked
summary: Oil prices swung as U.S.-Iran negotiations on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly session signaled possible de-escalation of Strait of Hormuz shipping disruptions. Kepler tanker-tracking data showed tanker flow adjustments ahead of a potential deal, limiting upside in crude.
why: Oil price volatility feeds into broader macro sentiment and risk-off/on positioning; sustained oil above $90 historically pressures HK/US equity multiples via inflation expectations and currency effects on HKD-pegged positions.

title: 港股科网股集体下挫：恒生指数收跌0.96%，恒生科技指数收跌0.99%
summary: 2026年9月25日港股收盘，科网权重板块整体承压，恒生指数收跌0.96%，恒生科技指数收跌0.99%，互联网蓝筹股普遍低走。
why: 腾讯、阿里、美团等港股科技是核心持仓，当日全板块下行直接压缩持仓市值；需关注恒科能否守住关键支撑位及是否触及在途期权行权价。

title: Costco Q4 FY2026 beats estimates: net sales $95.72B (+8% YoY), EPS $6.75, comparable sales +9.4% (SEC 8-K)
summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) filed an SEC Form 8-K on September 24, 2026 reporting Q4 FY2026 results: net sales of $95.72 billion, up approximately 8% year-over-year, diluted EPS of $6.75, and comparable sales growth of 9.4%. Membership fee revenue also increased. Results exceeded analyst consensus estimates.
why: Costco is a core holding; the strong Q4 beat confirms the membership-flywheel moat and margin resilience. Robust comps reduce near-term downside for options positions (sell-put on COST); the result may also compress near-term implied volatility.

title: 腾讯元宝鸿蒙（HarmonyOS）版正式上线，首发混元Hy4预览版（770亿参数）
summary: 腾讯AI助手「元宝」于2026年9月25日推出HarmonyOS专属版本，同步上线混元Hy4模型预览版，参数量770亿，强调端侧推理与多模态交互能力，进一步将AI产品线延伸至华为鸿蒙生态。
why: 腾讯（0700.HK）为核心持仓，元宝产品拓展鸿蒙生态体现AI商业化加速与生态卡位战略；Hy4升级有望提升元宝用户粘性，是混元大模型变现路径的关键节点。

title: 美团发布「放心外卖」七项专项行动，推出食安版功能并投入8000万元
summary: 美团于2026年9月23日宣布「放心外卖七项行动」，同步推出「食安版」功能，计划投入8000万元专项资金，围绕商家准入审核、配送温控、消费者投诉响应等维度系统提升外卖食品安全标准。
why: 美团（3690.HK）是核心持仓，此系主动合规举措，有助于降低监管风险敞口；8000万元投入对整体利润影响有限，但正面信号有助于维护品牌信誉与市场份额。
